summary: Imunon, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a September 28, 2026 Exchange Agreement with Streeterville Capital, LLC, exchanging $1.2 million of principal plus accrued interest under its Secured Promissory Note A-1 for 120 shares of newly designated Series B Preferred Stock at $10,000 per share. The certificate of designation authorizes 200 Series B shares with a $12,000 stated value and an 8% annual return. The exchange is a privately negotiated, unregistered Section 4(a)(2) issuance reducing debt; no board recommendation, advisor, premium, or closing date is stated. Watch for accretion, dilution from the remaining 80 authorized preferred shares, and further Streeterville exchanges.
